edges.effect_quant: Pooled meta-analytic evidence point in more than one direction, so no single pooled effect estimate is reliable enough to summarize cleanly.
edges.mechanism: This exposure is studied mainly through oxidative stress, endocrine disruption, inflammatory signaling, or direct tissue toxicity, with the dominant pathway varying by pollutant. For Dementia (all-cause), the main uncertainty is usually exposure measurement rather than complete biologic implausibility.
edges.summary: Pooled meta-analytic evidence link ground-level ozone to mixed effects on dementia (all-cause) in older adults. The average effect is usually unknown rather than dramatic, so this edge is better read as a risk modifier than a stand-alone cause or cure.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.
